title: Resource Acquirer
text: Acquire entity resources, 1 input, 5 outputs, {Event actions} sets the behavior of the entity on certain events; {Maximum number of waiting entities} sets the maximum number of entities that can wait, {Number of entities departed, d} sets the outputs the number of entities that have departed, {Number of entities in block, n} sets the outputs the number of entities present in the block, which have yet, {Average wait, w} sets the outputs the average wait time and {Number of entities extracted, ex} sets the number of entities extracted from this. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Port_d
ports.summary: Number of entities that have departed the block scalar

ports.name: Port_n
ports.summary: Number of entities that have not yet departed the block scalar

ports.name: Port_w
ports.summary: Average wait time for entities in the block scalar

params.name: Maximum number of waiting entities
params.values: Maximum number of entities that can wait for a resource 1 (default) | scalar

params.name: Event actions
params.values: Specify the behavior of the entity on certain events Entry (default) | Exit | Blocked

params.name: Number of entities departed, d
params.values: Outputs the number of entities that have departed the block off (default) | on

params.name: Number of entities in block, n
params.values: Outputs the number of entities present in the block, which have yet to depart off (default) | on

params.name: Average wait, w
params.values: Outputs the average wait time off (default) | on

params.name: Number of entities extracted, ex
params.values: Number of entities extracted from this block off (default) | on
